statement: Let a finite set X be partitioned into k ≥ 1 nonempty sets M1, . . . , Mk, and put G = Sym(X). Let Ha be the subgroup permuting Ma and fixing X \ Ma pointwise. Suppose that a probability measure ν on G satisfies, for some B ≥ 1, ν(gHa) ≤ B |Ha| |G| (g ∈ G, 1 ≤ a ≤ k). (5.2) 15 Then every irreducible complex unitary representation ρ of G, of dimension D, satisfies ∥b ν(ρ)∥2 op ≤ B D k X a=1 X π∈ b Ha dim π≤D1/k (dim π)2 . (5.3) The block sizes need not be equal.
